propositions: Failed LLM calls do not write rows to the usage log because record() is called after the exception handler in run(), leaving no record of burned tokens
Usage log spend totals silently underreport actual spend by omitting failed calls, causing billable CI job summaries to be incomplete
Per-step attribution cannot identify which steps failed because failed calls have no row distinguishable from calls that never occurred
A failed call must write a usage row with identifying fields (op, step, model_class, model, provider) and token counters, marked explicitly as failed and separable from successful calls
The fix records failed calls in an except block before re-raising, with an outcome field distinguishing success from failure to enable spend analysis
